# Hiking Trails

> > Comprehensive European hiking trail guides featuring long-distance routes, multi-day treks, and regional hiking destinations across the Pyrenees, Catalonia, Alps, and beyond.

Hiking Trails provides detailed trail information, gear reviews, and destination guides for hikers exploring Europe's most iconic routes including the Wolf Trail, HexaTrek, Laugavegur Trail, and regional trails in Spain, Switzerland, Austria, Slovenia, and beyond. The site features expert team contributors including trail guides, endurance runners, and expedition specialists.

## Key Topics

- Long-distance hiking
- Multi-day treks
- Pyrenees trails
- Catalonia hiking
- Hut-to-hut hiking
- European trails
- Mountain hiking
- Coastal trails
- Thru-hiking
- Wolf Trail
- Peaks of the Balkans
- Camino Frances
- Trail running shoes
- Costa Brava
- Moderate-difficulty trails

## Major Long-Distance Trails

- [Wolf Trail](https://hiking-trails.com/trail/wolf-trail): 3500km thru-hike from Poland through Alps to Mediterranean
- [HexaTrek](https://hiking-trails.com/trail/hexatrek): 3,034km France thru-hike from Vosges to Pyrenees through 14 parks
- [Laugavegur Trail](https://hiking-trails.com/trail/laugavegur-trail): 54km Iceland trail from Landmannalaugar to Þórsmörk

## Regional Hiking Guides

- [Hiking in Nepal](https://hiking-trails.com/hiking-in-nepal): Guide to Himalayan trekking in Nepal including Everest & Annapurna
- [Hiking in Catalonia](https://hiking-trails.com/hiking-in-catalonia): Catalonia hiking guide: coastal, Pyrenees & GR 92 trails

## Catalonia & Pyrenees Trails

- [Camí de Ronda](https://hiking-trails.com/trail/cami-de-ronda): Costa Brava coastal trail through Catalonia's seaside towns
- [Travessa dels 3 Refugis](https://hiking-trails.com/trail/travessa-dels-3-refugis): 50km hut-to-hut trail through Catalan Pyrenees from Queralbs
- [Ruta Estanys Amagats](https://hiking-trails.com/trail/ruta-estanys-amagats): 73km Hidden Lakes Route circular trail through Catalan/Andorran Pyrenees

## Gear Reviews

- [Gear review: LOWA ATR Amplux](https://hiking-trails.com/review/gear-review-lowa-atr-amplux): LOWA ATR Amplux trail running shoe review for long-distance hiking
- [HOKA Speedgoat 6 W Review](https://hiking-trails.com/review/hoka-speedgoat-6-w-review): HOKA Speedgoat 6 women's trail shoe review for mountain trails
